_comment: Reference only — this file is not installed anywhere.
These permissions used to live in the user-level ~/.claude/settings.json.
They belong to the repos they operate on, not to the laptop: a rule for
`aws eks describe-nodegroup` is a property of the infra codebase.
Copy the permissions block into `.claude/settings.json` at the root of the
relevant work repo and commit it. Claude Code merges allow lists across
layers, so project rules add to whatever the user file already grants.
Do NOT put them in .claude/settings.local.json — that file is for
